supportPurchases.title: Support the product
supportPurchases.description: Choose an optional one-time support purchase to help sustain continued development of Smart Expense.
supportPurchases.unchangedProduct: Every feature remains available to everyone. Product support does not change access, limits, roles, workspace data, or financial totals.
supportPurchases.pageDescription: Select one preset support tier. This is entirely optional and does not change the product experience.
supportPurchases.selectTierDescription: Each option is a one-time purchase.
supportPurchases.hostedCheckoutNote: Payment details are entered only on Stripe's secure hosted Checkout page.
supportPurchases.nativeBillingNote: The App Store or Google Play handles payment in its native purchase sheet. Smart Expense never shows payment-card fields.
supportPurchases.checkoutError: Secure checkout could not be opened. Try again.
supportPurchases.nativeProductsError: Store support options could not be loaded. Try again.
supportPurchases.nativePending: This support purchase is still processing at the store. It remains pending until the backend verifies it.
supportPurchases.nativeCancelled: The support purchase was cancelled. You can try again.
supportPurchases.nativeRefunded: This support purchase was refunded. Your product access is unchanged.
supportPurchases.nativeFailed: The store purchase could not be verified. Try again.
supportPurchases.tiersUnavailableDescription: The support options could not be loaded. Try again.
supportPurchases.pendingDescription: Stripe has not yet confirmed this support purchase. This page will update automatically after a verified webhook arrives.
supportPurchases.completedDescription: Thank you for supporting continued product development.
supportPurchases.failedDescription: The payment could not be completed. You can choose a support tier and try again.
supportPurchases.refundedDescription: This support purchase was refunded. Your access to the product is completely unchanged.

failureReasons.checkoutExpired: The secure checkout expired before payment was confirmed. You can try again.
failureReasons.paymentCancelled: The payment was cancelled before it was confirmed. You can try again.
failureReasons.paymentFailed: The payment could not be completed. You can try again.
failureReasons.storeCancelled: The store confirmed that the purchase was cancelled. You can try again.
failureReasons.storeFailed: The store could not complete this purchase. You can try again.
